Quick Guide to Electric Cars

How do electric cars work?

Electric cars use a battery to store energy and an electric motor to power the vehicle—no fuel, no exhaust emissions.

The battery

The battery is the core of the car and determines how far it can travel. It typically lasts between 8-15 years.

Charging types

  • Fast charging: Available at public stations.
  • Home charging (Wallbox): Most convenient.
  • Standard plug: Slower, but works as a backup.

Charging time

Varies by charger type, from under 1 hour (fast charging) to 4-8 hours at home.

Driving range

This is the distance the car can travel on a single charge, usually between 250-1000+ km depending on the model.

Running cost

Electric cars run on electricity instead of fuel, making them more cost-efficient over time.

Maintenance

Lower than traditional cars, with fewer moving parts and no need for oil changes.

FAQs

Where are the main public charging stations located in Egypt?

Public EV charging stations in Egypt are mainly concentrated in high-traffic, urban, and travel-friendly locations to make charging convenient during your daily routine or trips.

Here’s where you’ll typically find them:
Major cities (Cairo & Giza)

Most charging stations are located in areas like:
New Cairo & Fifth Settlement
Sheikh Zayed & 6th of October
Heliopolis & Nasr City
Maadi & Dokki

You’ll often find chargers in places like malls (e.g. City Stars), parking garages, and commercial hubs

Fuel stations (on-the-go charging)
Many traditional fuel stations are now equipped with EV chargers, such as:
ChillOut stations
Wataniya stations

Perfect for quick top-ups

How long does a full charge take and can I install a charger at home?

Charging time varies:
Fast charging stations: 30–60 minutes (up to 80%)
Home wall charger: 4–8 hours
Standard plug: 8–12+ hours

A certified technician will check your electrical setup and install a wall-mounted charger near your parking spot.
You’ll need a dedicated parking space or garage to safely install and access the charger.
Once installed, you can easily charge your car overnight

What are the best brands of electric cars?

Tesla → Best tech & performance
BYD → Best value for money
BMW / Mercedes → Best luxury
Hyundai / Kia → Best balance (price + features)
MG / Geely → Affordable & practical

How far can an electric car travel on a single charge?

It depends on the model, but most electric cars today offer a range between 250 to 500 km per charge.
Premium models can go even further.

Are electric cars safe?

Yes. Electric cars go through strict safety testing and often include advanced safety features.
The battery systems are well-protected and designed to handle extreme conditions.
